Recommends reconciliation against a source of truth, not only shape checks
expectations.evidence: "Compare the warehouse total against the authoritative source (your billing system, Stripe API, wherever the true revenue lives)"

expectations.text: Recommends a data contract or schema check so an upstream rename fails loudly and attributably

expectations.text: Recommends volume or null-rate assertions rather than only a non-empty check
